Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent was instructed to open the IMDb page for "Gamer (2009)" at the URL `https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0479952/`. However, the agent failed to correctly identify the film and instead loaded the page for "Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa (2008)", which is a completely different movie. This navigation error led to incorrect data being retrieved (showing Eric Darnell and Tom McGrath as directors) before the agent eventually realized the mistake and attempted a search in step 5. The error occurred because the agent executed the wrong URL or failed to verify the page content before proceeding, resulting in retrieving information for the wrong film.
